method: New continuous 3D pigment, sloughing, chin and shallow relief fields on a new non-overlapping atlas

atlas.repairReason: One small front-chin triangle folded in the generated chart; its geometry is unchanged and its own planar UV island removes the overlap.
atlas.smallChartReason: Very small source triangles were ignored by the automatic unwrap and given zero UVs; each receives a separate non-degenerate island. Geometry is unchanged.

seamRepair.method: Continuous field constrained at bilinear samples of chart boundary vertices

skinScope: Selected moderately worn adult; sloughing amount, chin islands and scars are variable and not a species-wide template.

baleenMaterial.method: Original numerical longitudinal keratin grain; no source colors or photo pixels
baleenMaterial.lingualFringes: Fine geometric ribbons; display density and thickness are illustrative
